rule_codes.PRES: admitted participant in the coop world on the current map epoch at the event tick (alive or dead/awaiting respawn); not lobby/loading/disconnected
rule_codes.COVER: per participant: set of distinct source ids of this kind for which the participant had PRES; award when the set reaches the threshold within one run
rule_codes.RUN: PRES at the finish event (user decision PR-1, 2026-11-04: presence at the finish is enough, as in single player); difficulty = GameInstance+0x1d8 at the finish
rule_codes.TEAM_FLAG: monotonic per-run team violation flag, never reset by death, respawn, leave, map change or save/load

user_decisions.PR-1: RUN = PRES at the finish; no whole-run coverage requirement
user_decisions.PR-2: imported state (SP save, pre-ledger coop save) is accepted: its doll bits, ankh bits and ankh count become the run baseline credited to participants admitted at the import; ankh count > 0 in the baseline sets TEAM_FLAG ankh_collected
user_decisions.PR-3: ACH_KILL_ENVIRONMENT goes to all PRES participants

import_baseline: COVER sets of participants admitted when an imported run starts are seeded with the imported doll/ankh bits; participants admitted later start empty (no retroactive credit)

run_taints.rule: host cheat flag (0x140107820 sets bit0 at DAT_140aeaf70+8) or campaign started via console map command -> no awards in this run for anyone
